name: analyst-desk
decided: The engine is one connector behind Claude and Excel, not a separate app.
Three ways in share one set of tools: invoke, ask, or be offered it at a failed lookup.
The offer is triggered by code, so no company name leaves the computer to make it.
Claude mode is off by default and needs a person to turn it on.
Application targets are not named in the video or the repo; the video says 'analyst'.
open: Run the add-in inside real Excel: Excel isn't installed on the build machine.
Where to host the web connector for Claude in Excel: public address or MCP tunnel.
Whether analysts accept the offer: needs a pilot; baseline unobserved.
Which model runs Claude mode for confidential lists.
why: The adoption pattern puts Claude where people work, tested tools in the middle and organised data underneath. The engine already had the tools and data; it lacked the ways in.
